title: Make water safe
summary: Strain cloudy water, then boil it for 1 minute, or treat it with unscented bleach.

steps: If the water is cloudy, let it settle, then strain it through a clean cloth.
Boil at a rolling boil for 1 minute. Above 6,500 ft, boil for 3 minutes.
No fire? Use unscented household bleach: 8 drops of 6% bleach (or 6 drops of 8.25%) per gallon. Double it for cloudy or very cold water. Stir and wait 30 minutes.
Tablets and filters: follow the maker’s directions. Most filters don’t stop viruses.

blocks.cap: Boiling is the most reliable method. Bleach must be plain, unscented and not expired.
